name: LKM / KPM Module Lab
description: Inspect, verify and scaffold out-of-tree kernel modules. Handles the two formats this project actually ships: LKM (.ko, buildable against a kernel tree) and KPM (.kpm, KernelPatch modules for arm64, loaded with kpatch rather than insmod).

panels.title: Module Lab
panels.subtitle: Vermagic, symbols, taint and build scaffolding for LKM and KPM
